title: The Wardrobe of Anderlecht
author: Ivo Thornbury
blurb: Hazel Ashgrove, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
